payload.title: Migrate the Markus site to Papyrus (dogfood first site)
payload.description: Markus site/ (index, gallery, gfm) is already pure Markus and builds with the standalone converter on GitHub Pages. Rebuild it through Papyrus build_markus_site + SiteChrome as in Apricity-web, keep the catppuccin theme and URLs, replace pages.yml. Easiest site, proves the pattern for repos that are not Papyrus pods.
